subject.title: [Feature]: Make working-claw tricks rare one-shot surprises

question: Should the Control UI adopt a default-loop-first working indicator with a rare, single delayed special move per run, and should the proposed 97%/3% rates be the approved product contract?
rationale: The issue defines a new visible interaction policy rather than repairing an established broken contract, and the maintained probabilities and timing affect the product’s personality and accessibility expectations.

options.title: Approve the one-shot design
options.body: Adopt the default-loop-first design and use the proposed rates as the initial product contract, with reduced-motion preserved.

options.title: Approve the pattern, tune later
options.body: Adopt one-shot special moves but ask the implementation to use maintainer-chosen rates and delay values before landing.

options.title: Keep the current behavior
options.body: Retain repeated alternate modes and close the proposal without changing the working indicator policy.

recommendation.title: Approve the one-shot design
recommendation.body: Adopt the default-loop-first design and use the proposed rates as the initial product contract, with reduced-motion preserved.
